visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with light-colored hair pulled back sits on a grey sofa, wearing a dark grey t-shirt. She speaks with an expressive but strained facial expression while holding a purple smartphone in her left hand. The lighting is bright and indoor. (2) A man wearing a grey t-shirt and a camouflage cap appears beside the woman on the sofa. He looks directly into the camera lens and makes a hand gesture while speaking. The background features a plain white wall and a portion of the grey couch. (3) The man is shown sitting at a desk with large black headphones resting around his neck. He looks intently at a computer monitor. The background is a white wall with a black-and-white checkered acoustic panel visible to the left. (4) A top-down close-up view displays the ingredients: four round slices of fresh ginger in a small purple dish, a white and red box of herbal syrup, and several individual-serving sachets spread on a white countertop surface. (5) In a clean, modern kitchen environment, the man uses a small stainless steel pot to boil water on an induction stovetop. He holds a digital timer showing 10:00 and presses the start button to begin the cooking process. (6) The man carefully pours the hot ginger water into a tall glass half-filled with clear water. He then adds honey from a squeeze bottle and pours the dark liquid from a small red and silver sachet into the glass. (7) Using a metal spoon, the man stirs the dark brown mixture in the glass. He holds the finished drink up toward the camera, smiling with a sense of accomplishment. The kitchen cabinets and range hood are visible behind him. (8) Back in the living room setting on the grey sofa, the man hands the prepared glass to the woman. She takes the glass with both hands and drinks the mixture while he watches her with a concerned expression. (9) The woman smiles broadly and touches her throat with her right hand, indicating relief. The man, also smiling, places his hand on her shoulder in a supportive gesture. The soft indoor lighting highlights their positive expressions.
